simple.meaning: תְּפִלָּה (tᵉphillâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “intercession , supplication ; by implication, a hymn.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 77 times in 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Nehemiah, and 9 more, beginning at 2 Samuel 7:27. The surrounding contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּפִלָּה (H8605) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: תְּפִלָּה (tᵉphillâh) / H8605 is traced through 2 Samuel 7:27, 1 Kings 8:28, 1 Kings 8:29, 1 Kings 8:38 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: intercession , supplication ; by implication, a hymn
definitions.full: H8605. tephillah תְּפִלָּה 77 noun feminine prayer ; — ׳ת Isa 1:15 +, construct תְּמִּלַּת Psa 80:5 +; suffix תְּפלָּתִי 4:2 +, etc.; plural תְּפִלּוֺת 72:20 ; — 1. a. prayer , 1Kin 8:38 2Chr 6:29 ; Isa 1:15 ; Psa 35:13 ; 80:5 +. b. pray a prayer , ׳הִתְפ ׳ת 2Sam 7:27 ; 1Kin 8:54 (compare 8:28 ; 8:29 2Chr 6:19-20 ,); בַּתּ ׳דִּבֶּר Dan 9:21 ; specifically of intercession, ת ׳נשׂא , with בְּעַד in behalf of 2Kin 19:4 = Isa 37:4 ; Jer 7:16 ; 11:14 . c. ׳ת אֶלאֱֿלֹהִים 2Chr 33:18 , לְאֵל Psa 42:9 , compare 69:14 ; with verb + לפני 88:3 ; 141:2 ; ׳תּ תְּקַדְּמֶ֑ךָּ 88:14 . d. ת ׳בית Isa 56:7 (twice in verse) house of prayer (temple); with verb + ׳אֶליֿ + אלהֿיכל Jonah 2:8 ; with verb + קדשׁו למעון 2Chr 30:27 . e. hear prayer ת (אֶתֿ) ׳שׁמע 1Kin 8:45 , 49 2Chr 6:35 , 39 ; 1Kin 9:3 ; Psa 4:2 ; 39:13 9 t.; אֶלתֿ ׳שׁמע 1Kin 8:28-29 , 2Chr 6:19-20 , Neh 1:6 ; Dan 9:17 ; ת ׳פנהאל 1Kin 8:28 2Chr 6:19 ; Psa 102:18 ; לת קַשֻּׁבוֺת ׳אָזְנֶיךָ 2Chr 6:40 ; 7:15 , compare Neh 1:11 ( אֶל ), ׳ת הַקְשִׁיבָה Psa 61:2 ; ת בְּקוֺל ׳הִקְשִׁיבּ 66:19 ; ת ׳הַאֲזִינָה 17:1 ; 55:2 ; 86:6 ; ת ׳לקח 6:10 ; compare 66:20 ; 102:18 b. 2 in Psalm-titles, poetic, liturgical prayer Psa 17:1 ; 86:1 ; 90:1 ; 102:1 ; 142:1 ; Hab 3:1 ; of Davidic Psalter, דוד תפלות Psa 72:20 .
